The thing about tryptophobia or the phobia of needles is that it is one of the few phobias that can actually kill you. If you are too wound up, and have too drastic of a blood pressure change from high to low when the needle goes in you can go into shock, coma or even have cardiac arrest and die. I had a bruise on the underside of my forearm for over 2 weeks from where she jabbed that needle into me...
